BC_description: When the encoding option is set to 'buffer', the output (result.stdout, result.stderr, result.all) now returns a Uint8Array instead of a Buffer. The encoding: null option has also been removed.
Adaptation_method:
Update code that expects Buffer instances to work with Uint8Array instead. Buffer methods will need to be replaced with Uint8Array equivalents or you can convert Uint8Array to Buffer using Buffer.from() if needed.

Before:
```js
const {stdout} = await execa('node', ['file.js'], {encoding: 'buffer'});
console.log(stdout instanceof Buffer); // true
```

After:
```js
const {stdout} = await execa('node', ['file.js'], {encoding: 'buffer'});
console.log(stdout instanceof Uint8Array); // true
// If Buffer is needed:
const stdoutBuffer = Buffer.from(stdout);
```

Also note that the `encoding: null` option has been removed. Use `encoding: 'buffer'` instead.
